IGUI_LWX_TerminalLinked: Terminal linked: its block has power.
IGUI_LWX_ZoneTooBig: The zone is limited to 2 x 2 blocks (16 x 16 squares).
IGUI_LWX_ZoneTooFar: The zone must stay next to the terminal: within one block of its own.
IGUI_LWX_ZoneToolHelp: Click and drag on the ground to draw the zone.
IGUI_LWX_PanelLinked: Breaker board linked. Install breakers to wire the appliances.
IGUI_LWX_BreakerNoPoints: Module %1: this breaker controls no appliance. Wire one from the board or from the appliance.
IGUI_LWX_BreakerTripped: A breaker tripped: module %1 was overloaded.
IGUI_LWX_BoardEmpty: No breaker yet. Install one with a screwdriver.
IGUI_LWX_Meter: %1 kWh today, %2 kWh yesterday, %3 kWh in 7 days
IGUI_LWX_Released: Every breaker is back on and no board cuts anymore (%1 points restored). LiveWire Extended can be removed.
IGUI_LWX_SelectHint: Click a breaker to see its circuit; click its lever to switch it.
IGUI_LWX_EmptyHint: Click an empty module to install a breaker you carry there.
IGUI_LWX_TintLegend: While this window is open: red = wired to no board (no power), green = this board, blue = breaker off, grey = another board.
IGUI_LWX_NoRegion: This board hangs outside: it serves no building. Hang it on an inside wall of a building, or close and roof the room it hangs in.
IGUI_LWX_Rating: %1 A at 120 V: up to %2 W
